instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Freight forwarding and customs brokerage firm managing sea, air, and road shipments for 200+ SME importers and exporters. Processing ~300 customs declarations monthly. Seeking to implement automated customs document classification and regulatory change monitoring across 15 trade corridors. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly. Annual capex budget for innovation exists but deployment is gated by rigorous ROI modeling and steering committee approval.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: Growth is our existential mandate. We are losing market share to faster-moving competitors and need to reignite our growth trajectory. We are willing to make significant strategic bets — potentially including M&A, new product lines, or geographic expansion — provided they have a credible path to meaningful revenue contribution within 18 months.
answers.teamSize: Our digital and innovation organization includes 80+ professionals across centers of excellence for AI/ML, cloud engineering, UX design, and agile delivery. We run an internal incubator program that has graduated 6 new digital products to market in the past 2 years, alongside a corporate venture capital arm that makes strategic minority investments in relevant startups.

input.changes_since_last: Supply chain disruptions affected 2 product lines. Inventory digitalization project launched. Margins under pressure.

opportunities.title: Establish a Federated Digital Operating Model for Core Processes
opportunities.rationale: The current matrix structure and business unit autonomy are creating adoption variance, slowing systemic improvements needed for growth. A federated model centralizes the 'what' (data standards, core processes) while allowing local units control over the 'how,' mitigating resistance.

first_actions: Establish a cross-functional governing body (CDTO + BU leaders) to define 3 standardized data exchange APIs for top trade corridors.
Map mandatory compliance touchpoints (e.g., customs documentation, sanctions screening) into the centralized process blueprint to ensure regulatory adherence.
Pilot the new federated model on the most disrupted product line using the internal incubator team.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time taken to implement new regulatory process across 5 major BUs by 20%
milestones: Governing body established and charter signed
Core platform blueprint (MVP) defined and approved
Successful pilot deployment on first product line

opportunities.title: Develop a Scalable Market Entry/M&A Due Diligence Framework
opportunities.rationale: Given the strategic mandate for growth, relying on ad-hoc M&A or expansion efforts is high risk. Formalizing a playbook will accelerate market readiness and ensure rapid assessment of local regulatory complexity and operational synergies.

first_actions: Define 3 core success vectors (e.g., Digital Integration Potential, Regulatory Ease, Market Size) for new geographies/targets.
Build a digitized deal-sourcing funnel incorporating external expert network feedback and internal market analysts.
Mandate legal and compliance review at the initial screening stage.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in average time-to-shortlist for potential expansion targets by 30%
milestones: Due Diligence Playbook v1.0 completed and trained on executive committee
Framework tested on one simulated target market

next_steps.action: Formalize the governance structure for digital initiatives (CDTO/Business Unit leadership) to drive adoption of the federated model.
Re-evaluate and adjust the annual innovation budget allocation, specifically ring-fencing funds for foundational process standardization rather than only isolated projects.
Run a 'Lessons Learned' workshop immediately following the inventory digitalization project launch to extract best practices and failure points for immediate application across other product lines.

key_weaknesses: Governing Model Friction: The matrix structure allows innovation funds to exist, but the autonomous nature of business units dilutes adoption and prevents systemic scale.
Budget Constraint Impact: A sharp reduction in allocated capex (7% down to 4%) requires a pivot from large exploratory bets toward high-ROI maintenance/optimization plays.
Talent Utilization Bottleneck: While the talent base is vast, cultural silos prevent the centralized innovation functions (AI/ML) from being deployed seamlessly across all required business units.

improvements: Successful initiation of core digitalization efforts via the Inventory Digitalization project.
The company demonstrated agility by maintaining a high-performing, diverse team structure (80+ professionals) and leveraging its internal incubator/VC arms despite market pressure.
persistent_gaps: Lack of standardized governance model to bridge central strategic mandates with local unit execution.
The core barrier remains cultural adoption; technical capability does not guarantee operational rollout success across all geographical units.
achieved_milestones: Digitalization project launched, addressing a supply chain vulnerability. Focus shifted from theoretical innovation to practical, revenue-impacting digitization.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company remains highly capable and formally structured (Innovation Maturity: Formal). However, market pressures, budget reductions, and internal resistance to central governance require a shift in focus from general capability building to operational process standardization and measurable revenue generation through controlled growth.
